analysis_summary: Episode 600 anniversary special of Borspodden featuring Simon Blecker (CIO Carnegie Fonder) and Peter Benson (Affarsvarlden). Main themes: Strong bullish case for Swedish commercial real estate (Fabege, Atrium Ljungberg, John Mattson) trading at massive discounts to NAV and transaction values. European markets outperforming US, contrarian view that consensus US/Magnificent 7 trade is crowded. Skepticism about Swedish small caps as asset class. Discussion of inflation persistence and rate outlook.
